title: Knockout punch set, 1/2, 3/4 and 1 in conduit

sources.citation: Standard round knockout punch units (punch, die and draw stud) for 1/2, 3/4 and 1 in conduit, as in one maker's catalogue read 2026-11-15 (maker not named in content): driven by a wrench, ratchet or hydraulic driver, they cut mild steel up to 10 gauge (3.5 mm) and make the 0.885, 1.115 and 1.362 in holes of KNOCKOUT_HOLES. Entry walls are taken to be within that capacity (not checked); no conductor size is involved.
